executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: Context and asynchronous state could outlive their intended run or selection; fixes recorded without erasing historical findings.
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: Complete live GitHub read/approval/write/receipt verification when scoped credentials and write authority are available.

layers.name: System prompt
layers.observation: One explicit system policy; retrieved content marked untrusted; broker authority is enforced in code.

layers.name: Session history
layers.observation: Run-linked history excludes future queued prompts and orders prior replies before current prompt.

layers.name: Long-term memory
layers.observation: Owner-scoped explicit/inferred/episodic records; explicit preference priority; revision/expiry/delete/export; live correction/deletion recall.

layers.name: Distillation
layers.observation: No automatic distillation layer or synthetic compressed facts are admitted to memory.

layers.name: Active recall
layers.observation: Single bounded preference retrieval plus recent conversation; no second summarizer.

layers.name: Tool selection
layers.observation: Required research reads are code-gated; unknown and stale skills fail closed; per-skill tool allowlists.

layers.name: Tool execution
layers.observation: Enabled/scope/revision/expiry rechecked; exact approval; note intent and issue receipt persisted; uncertain effects reconciled without blind write retry.

layers.name: Tool interpretation
layers.observation: Malformed provider shapes fail visibly; evidence URLs validated in proposals and answers; GitHub confirmation matches approved arguments.

layers.name: Answer shaping
layers.observation: Validated content rendered as escaped text; sources appended from persisted evidence; no hidden model rewrite.

layers.name: Platform rendering
layers.observation: Latest-request guards preserve current search/run/note state; expired sessions unmount private UI.

layers.name: Hidden repair loops
layers.observation: No fallback model or silent answer repair. Limited read/search retries; bounded worker restart recovery is durable and visible.

layers.name: Persistence
layers.observation: Message migration, skill hashes, revision-bound approvals, leases, intent/receipt checkpoints and error clearing.

findings.title: Queued future prompt contamination
findings.mechanism: History was selected by conversation without the current run cutoff.
findings.recommended_fix: Add nullable run association and temporal cutoff; preserve old messages.

findings.title: Unknown/stale skill authority
findings.mechanism: Unknown IDs fell back to conversation authority and queued definition hashes were not checked.
findings.root_cause: Fallback granted tools outside declared skill contract.
findings.recommended_fix: Reject unknown IDs and reject stale recorded hashes before dispatch.

findings.title: Uncertain local effect lost after subsequent failure
findings.mechanism: A note was persisted, then a later model failure marked run failed without recovery UI.
findings.root_cause: Failure classification considered external actions but omitted note intents.
findings.recommended_fix: Classify note effects uncertain and allow read-only reconciliation after cancellation.

findings.title: Unsupported citations in issue proposal
findings.mechanism: Proposal source URLs escaped the final-output validator.
findings.root_cause: Validation only covered final answer text.
findings.recommended_fix: Share persisted-evidence validation for proposal and answer boundaries.

findings.title: Stale responses overwrite current views
findings.mechanism: Older asynchronous reads replaced newer mutation/selection state.
findings.root_cause: Request completion order was mistaken for user intent order.
findings.recommended_fix: Sequence guards, current query reference and pending-operation count.

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Restore context and tool authority boundaries
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Wrong run data or widened tools affect operational behavior.
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Future context excluded, stale/unknown skills denied.

ordered_fix_plan.why_now: A failed response is not evidence that an effect did not happen.
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Read-only reconciliation and no blind repeated writes.

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Preserve current browser intent across delayed responses
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Stale UI can misrepresent persisted action state.
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Current selection and mutation state remain visible.

ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Controlled transport cannot certify real external permissions or writes.
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Actual repository reads and confirmed issue receipt.

limits: No independent penetration test or broad model-quality benchmark.
No hard wall-clock process kill; cancellation takes effect at authorized dispatch boundaries.
Live GitHub and remote deployment remain unverified.
